facts.fact: The Uganda Communications Commission re-advertised on 2026-09-29, through UCUSAF, which draws on levies paid by telecom operators, a call for one implementing partner to run Phase III of the National e-Booster Programme planned for FY2026/27; the document does not name the law that sets up the levy.
facts.system: UCUSAF (Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund)

systems.country_label: Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund

note: The e-Booster programme gives no amount, so no allocated fact.
